jobs.title: AI Engineer (Python)
jobs.description:
Who We Are
We are looking for Artificial Intelligence Engineering Experts to lead the design, industrialization, and continuous improvement of production AI capabilities for our platform. The role will provide deep hands-on expertise across machine learning, generative AI, data and model pipelines, evaluation, deployment, MLOps or LLMOps, observability, security, and operational reliability.
The experts will work with Product, Architecture, Data, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Quality Assurance, DevOps, and business stakeholders to identify viable use cases and convert experimentation into governed, measurable, maintainable services. They will establish technical standards, challenge weak assumptions, manage AI-specific risks, and mentor teams in sound engineering and scientific practices.
What You'll Be Doing
Assess proposed AI use cases for technical feasibility, data readiness, expected value, operational constraints, risk, and appropriate build, buy, or reuse options
Define AI engineering reference architectures, reusable components, lifecycle standards, guardrails, and decision criteria for machine-learning and generative-AI solutions
Lead solution design across data preparation, feature or context engineering, model selection, experimentation, training or fine-tuning, evaluation, serving, integration, and monitoring
Develop and optimize production AI components, including predictive models, retrieval pipelines, embeddings, vector search, generative workflows, tool use, and agentic orchestration where justified
Establish reproducible experimentation, source control, dataset and model versioning, metadata capture, benchmark management, and clear promotion criteria
Design and implement MLOps or LLMOps pipelines for automated testing, packaging, security checks, deployment, rollback, model or prompt promotion, and environment consistency
Create rigorous evaluation frameworks covering task performance, robustness, groundedness, hallucination, safety, bias, explainability, latency, scalability, and cost as applicable
Define production monitoring for model and data quality, drift, usage, errors, safety events, service performance, resource consumption, and business outcomes
Apply security, privacy, responsible-AI, and regulatory-by-design controls, including data minimization, access control, provenance, human oversight, misuse prevention, and auditable records
Lead technical reviews, proofs of value, architecture decisions, technology assessments, and root-cause analyses for material AI incidents or performance degradation
Collaborate with application engineers to expose AI capabilities through reliable APIs, services, event flows, and user experiences with appropriate fallback behavior
Document data assumptions, model choices, experiments, limitations, evaluation evidence, dependencies, operational procedures, risks, and technical decisions
Mentor AI, data, and software engineers, promote knowledge sharing, and raise engineering maturity across delivery teams
Track relevant AI engineering developments and recommend adoption only when evidence demonstrates value, feasibility, and acceptable risk
What You'll Bring Along
Deep knowledge of machine-learning engineering, model development lifecycles, statistics, supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, and production inference
Strong hands-on Python experience and familiarity with frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent technologies
Advanced understanding of generative-AI engineering, large language models, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, prompt or context engineering, tool calling, and agent orchestration
Experience with data preparation, feature engineering, data quality, lineage, distributed processing, SQL or NoSQL stores, and secure access to enterprise information
Experience with MLOps or LLMOps practices, experiment tracking, model registries, pipeline orchestration, containerization, cloud AI services, and automated deployment
Strong knowledge of model evaluation, benchmarking, error analysis, drift detection, explainability, robustness, safety testing, and human-in-the-loop validation
Understanding of AI security, privacy, responsible-AI, governance, intellectual-property, and regulatory control considerations
Ability to design reliable distributed services, APIs, batch or streaming pipelines, observability, capacity models, and production-support processes for AI workloads
Strong scientific reasoning, systems thinking, technical leadership, documentation, and communication skills
Ability to explain complex AI trade-offs to engineering, product, risk, compliance, and executive stakeholders
Professional working proficiency in English to understand technical and scientific documentation and communicate effectively with international teams
Proven expert-level track record designing, delivering, and operating production machine-learning or generative-AI systems
Experience working with AI assistant platforms and CLI tools
Demonstrable ability to move from experimentation to reliable, monitored, secure, and maintainable production services
Experience providing technical leadership across data, AI, Agent development, software engineering, architecture, platform, security, and governance stakeholders
Strong hands-on engineering capability; profiles limited to research, strategy, or demonstrations without production ownership will not be sufficient
Ability to make evidence-based decisions under uncertainty and to define measurable acceptance and operational criteria for AI behavior
Proactive, rigorous, collaborative, and continuous-improvement mindset with strong ownership of AI quality and operational risk
Relevant AI, machine-learning, cloud, data, security, or architecture certifications are desirable but not mandatory

jobs.title: BI Developer with Python
jobs.description:
At
YouGov Shopper
, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining business intelligence solutions that transform complex market research data into actionable business insights. This includes developing robust data models, interactive dashboards, and automated reporting solutions that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions.
You will leverage
Python, AI technologies, and modern analytics tools
to automate data preparation, reporting processes, and data quality controls, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and scalability across reporting environments. Additionally, you will develop and enhance AI-powered capabilities, such as natural language querying, automated insight generation, and intelligent data analysis features, helping stakeholders access and understand data more effectively.
Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff):
Design, build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in BI tools following design specifications.
Build and optimise data models (star schemas, DAX measures/calculated fields), keeping performance and refresh times under control.
Develop Python scripts and pipelines (pandas, SQL) to extract, clean, transform and validate data from multiple sources.
Write and optimise SQL queries against relational databases and cloud data warehouses.
Automate recurring reporting, data quality checks and delivery tasks with Python, reducing manual effort for the DA&I organization.
Apply AI and LLM tools to BI work: natural-language Q&A over data, automated commentary and insight summaries, anomaly detection and AI-assisted development (e.g., Power BI Copilot, Azure OpenAI, LLM APIs).
Translate requests from local teams into clear BI requirements, KPIs and solution designs.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency: reconcile figures, document metric definitions and use version control.
Update and bug-fix dashboards and reports according to assigned tickets.
Communication – keep the management team and key stakeholders updated on project progress and issues, and keep project tracking up to date.
Document data sources, models and solutions, and share best practices within the team.
These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview:
Very good skills in BI tools, including data modelling and DAX or calculated fields.
Strong SQL skills.
Good Python skills for data work (pandas, NumPy), scripting and automation.
Understanding of data warehousing, ETL/ELT and dimensional modelling.
Experience with, or strong interest in, applying AI/LLMs to analytics: prompting, LLM APIs and AI features in BI tools (e.g., Power BI Copilot).
Data visualization and dashboard design best practices.
Very good skills in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).
Market research and statistical knowledge.
Git/version control; Microsoft Fabric, Power Automate or cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) are a plus.
Good level of English (for both oral and written communication).
We offer a hybrid working model in an exciting work environment that brings people together – our office is located @ Victoriei, near subway, with great fitout, 3 days per week working from home:
Initial and ongoing trainings to support your development.
Opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Food vouchers & Medlife Private medical subscription
Sponsored Gym Membership (7Card).
And much more...!
All documents will be treated in the strictest confidentiality.
Only short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview.

jobs.title: Python AI Agent Engineer (Mid-level)
jobs.description:
Location: Bucharest, Romania
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.
Role: Python AI Agent Engineer (Mid-level)
About the Mission:
Join us in building the future of AI-enhanced engineering. We're creating a revolutionary agent garden from the ground up—a programmatic system that will enable 40,000+ engineers to seamlessly work with AI agents, tools, and data.
As an
Agent Garden Developer
, you'll work on the core infrastructure that powers this system: building agents, creating connectors, implementing orchestration logic, and enabling the marketplace where engineers discover and contribute to AI services.
This is a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI and software engineering, learn from experienced tech leads, and contribute to a system that will have massive real-world impact.
What We Offer:
Mentorship program: Learn from experienced tech leads and principal engineers
Growth opportunities: Clear development path with support for advancing your skills
Agile, autonomous teams with management-free delivery, clear roles, and predictability focus
Modern tech stack: Work with latest AI/ML technologies, frameworks, and tools
Why This Role is Exciting:
Work with Cutting-Edge AI: get hands-on experience building agentic AI systems
Learn from Experts: work alongside tech leads and principal engineers who will mentor you
Massive Impact: your code will power a system used by 40,000+ engineers
Greenfield Project: build new infrastructure with modern technologies while connecting to existing systems
Career Growth: clear path to senior roles with mentorship, challenging projects, opportunities to lead
What You'll Do:
Build Agent Infrastructure:
Develop agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors and more
Build frameworks making it easy for others to create and deploy agents
Contribute to the programmatic (code-first) system architecture
Integrate AI with Engineering Tools:
Work with AI/ML APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) to build intelligent features
Implement prompt engineering patterns and interaction flows
Connect AI capabilities with engineering tools (e.g., GitLab, Polarion, data sources)
Build authentication and authorization for secure multi-system integration
Write High-Quality Code:
Follow software craftsmanship principles: TDD, clean code, living documentation
Write unit and integration tests for your components
Participate in code reviews and learn from senior engineers
Document your work to help others build upon it
Grow Your Skills:
Work closely with tech leads and principal engineers who will mentor you
Learn emerging technologies: agentic AI, prompt engineering, MCP
Take increasing ownership of features and components
Share your learnings with the team and contribute to knowledge base
About you:
Your Experience:
Backend development: Python, Kotlin, Node.js, or similar languages
API integration: Worked with RESTful APIs, understand authentication fundamentals
Problem-solving: Can break down complex problems and implement solutions
Collaboration: Worked in team environments using Git and code reviews
Your Technical Skills:
Programming: Python or other backend languages (Java, Node.js, Kotlin)
APIs: RESTful design, HTTP, JSON, authentication (OAuth, JWT)
Data handling: Databases (SQL or NoSQL), data processing
Testing: Unit testing, basic integration testing
Tools: Git, basic CI/CD, command-line proficiency
Cloud services: Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Your Approach:
Quality-conscious: Care about writing code that works reliably
Test-aware: Understand value of automated testing and TDD/BDD practices (even if still building these skills)
Eager to learn craftsmanship: Excited to grow your software craftsmanship practices
At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
